segment_summary: দৈনন্দিন সংগ্রামের ফলে শারীরিক ও মানসিক ক্লান্তি তাকে গ্রাস করলেও, তার মনোবল কীভাবে ভেঙে পড়ছে না, সেই দ্বৈরথ এখানে দেখানো হয়েছে।

segment_enrichment.angle: Focusing entirely on the internal monologue addressed to a memory of Likhindor, using his absence as the primary catalyst for endurance.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: The threshold of the ancestral home; Desire: A single, unjudged glance from an elder relative; Obstacle: The weight of past pronouncements against her character; Turn: She turns toward the horizon instead of looking inwards.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Shifting focus entirely onto how her *internal* perception of time warps under duress—moments stretching into epochs of endurance.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The metallic taste of suppressed grief coating the tongue at twilight.
segment_enrichment.research_question: What specific ancient vocabulary exists that denotes endurance achieved *without* divine intervention?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: A cyclical structure built around the recurrence of one single physical gesture (e.g., touching her own wrist) across all eight segments.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: This chapter deliberately slows the narrative momentum compared to previous segments by foregrounding pure internal friction; where before was external conflict, here it is relentless self-erosion versus stubborn will.
